examples.name: OnSurfaces
examples.summary: The same placeholder on all four surface layers. The fill is `var(--bg-placeholder)`, a translucent role rather than an opaque surface, so it composites over whatever sits behind it and holds its contrast on every layer — in both themes. Built from a surface token instead, a placeholder is only legible on the one surface it was picked against.
